title: Apple opens its new Siri AI to everyone with the iOS 27 public beta
description: If you’ve been waiting to try Apple’s revamped Siri without installing a developer beta, you now can. The company on Tuesday released the iOS 27 public beta, giving iPhone owners early access to its AI-powered assistant and other new features before the software’s official launch this fall.
author: Sarah Perez

title: Anthropic’s newest ad is creeping people out
description: Anthropic has consistently attempted to depict itself as the ethical foil to other AI companies. This latest marketing stunt — which leans into criticism of AI as a way to make Anthropic seem aware of the responsibility it carries — would appear to be more of the same.
author: Lucas Ropek

title: The founder of Hinge raised $18M to build a new AI dating service, Overtone
description: Overtone describes itself as "a voice- and audio-forward service, enabled by AI, that provides highly curated introductions."
author: Amanda Silberling

title: Google faces another AI training lawsuit from major publishers
description: Hachette, Cengage, Elsevier, and other publishers allege that Google trained its AI on copyrighted works without the necessary permissions.
author: Amanda Silberling

title: DeepMind CEO calls for an independent standards body to regulate frontier AI
description: DeepMind CEO Demis Hassabis is proposing an AI "standards body" modeled after FINRA, to test frontier models and develop best practices for their release.
author: Russell Brandom

title: Meta’s Adam Mosseri says AI token budgets could soon be capped per engineer
description: Instagram head Adam Mosseri believes companies will eventually need to manage AI token spending the same way they manage payroll or other operating expenses, predicting that engineers could soon face limits on how much they spend using AI tools.
author: Sarah Perez

title: Google Images gets a Pinterest-like redesign focused on discovery
description: Now, when users navigate to Google Images, they'll see a "For You" gallery of images tailored to their interests and browsing history.
author: Aisha Malik

title: New York State halts construction of all new data centers
description: New York has become the first state to temporarily halt approval of large data centers, as Gov. Kathy Hochul argues the AI-driven building boom shouldn’t come at the expense of higher electricity costs, water supplies, or local control.
author: Tim De Chant

title: Reflection inks $1B compute deal with Nebius
description: Reflection AI has signed a $1 billion deal to access Nebius' compute. Reflection was founded in 2024 and is developing open source AI technology.
author: Rebecca Bellan

title: The real AI race may no longer be at the frontier
description: Hugging Face CEO Clem Delangue says enterprises increasingly want open models, due to cost, accessibility, and ownership. Do frontier models still matter if most production AI ends up running on open models?
author: Rebecca Bellan

title: Spotify expands its AI push with a ChatGPT-like music assistant
description: Spotify is rolling out a new AI-powered conversational feature that lets Premium subscribers chat with the app to discover music, podcasts, audiobooks, and more.
author: Sarah Perez

title: Superhuman’s new auto-draft feature almost makes me like AI replies
description: Superhuman’s latest AI email drafting feature is its most convincing yet, generating replies that often required little to no editing in our testing.
author: Ivan Mehta

title: Already rich, already successful, why the last wave of tech winners is grinding again
description: They're rolling up their sleeves again, seemingly out of fear of missing AI's defining moment and, presumably, the irresistible allure of making even more money -- potentially a lot more.
author: Connie Loizos

title: Uber’s product chief on hotels, robotaxis, and why the company doesn’t want to be “everything for everyone”
description: Uber Chief Product Officer Sachin Kansal walks TechCrunch through the company's financial-services ambitions, its increasingly complicated relationship with Waymo, its new AV Labs data operation, and how AI is starting to show up in ways riders and drivers will actually notice.
author: Connie Loizos

title: Video-generation startup PixVerse raises $439M, valuation soars past $2B
description: With the cash, the company aims to expand its world model offering and reach customers across geographies.
author: Ivan Mehta

title: Hermes agent maker Nous Research in talks for new funding at $1.5B valuation
description: The company is raising at least $75 million, led by Robot Ventures, with significant participation from USV and other prominent investors.
author: Ivan Mehta, Marina Temkin

title: Satya Nadella has issued a shocking warning to companies using AI
description: Of all the debates raging about the potential downsides of AI, there is one worry causing the most hand-wringing among AI enthusiasts in Silicon Valley — that the giant AI labs that sell proprietary models are somehow acting like Trojan horses.
author: Julie Bort

title: The wildest allegations in Apple’s trade secrets lawsuit against OpenAI
description: Apple’s trade secrets lawsuit against OpenAI contains allegations that range from employees joking about unauthorized access to Apple’s systems to claims that job candidates were asked to bring Apple hardware to interviews. Here are the complaint’s most eye-catching claims.
author: Sarah Perez

title: Sam Altman’s space data center trash talk is what most experts already believe
description: Responding to Musk accusing him of being a scammer, Altman said, "homeboy you're the one sellling [sic] public market investors on short-term space datacenters."
author: Tim Fernholz

title: Should AI help you get away with killing your spouse?
description: What does a world of total user-aligned AI actually look like?
author: Russell Brandom

title: Anthropic starts localizing Claude pricing for India, its biggest market after the US
description: Claude users in India are starting to see Indian rupee-denominated subscription plans.
author: Jagmeet Singh

title: Waze adds new AI-powered features and customization updates
description: Some of the new features are powered by Google's Gemini AI assistant, which reflects the tech giant's broader push to integrate Gemini across its products while also better positioning Waze to compete with rival services such as Apple Maps.
author: Aisha Malik

title: OpenAI bets on families as ChatGPT goes deeper into households
description: ChatGPT is hiring a dedicated product manager to build experiences for families, caregivers, and older adults, according to a job posting.
author: Jagmeet Singh

title: Meta removes controversial AI feature on Instagram after backlash
description: "Our intent was to provide a useful creative tool and to give people control over whether their public content could be referenced in this way," the company said in a blog post. "We've heard the feedback that this feature missed the mark, so it's no longer available."
author: Lucas Ropek

title: Apple sues OpenAI over alleged trade secret theft
description: Apple alleges the misconduct was directed by OpenAi's senior leadership, including a long-time former employee.
author: Sarah Perez

title: Open source AI matters more than ever, according to Hugging Face’s Clem Delangue
description: Open source AI is booming, according to Hugging Face CEO Clem Delangue. The company has grown into something like a GitHub for AI in recent years, where AI builders can share and download open models and datasets, now used by roughly half the Fortune 500. Delangue has seen the same story play out again and again: companies start […]
author: Rebecca Bellan, Theresa Loconsolo

title: SK Hynix raises $26.5B in the biggest foreign IPO in US history, is urged to build new US fabs
description: The AI chip boom just produced its biggest Wall Street moment yet. Now SK Hynix and Samsung are being asked to build U.S. factories.
author: Kate Park

title: Hugging Face’s CEO on why companies are done renting their AI
description: Open source AI is booming, according to Hugging Face CEO Clem Delangue. The company has grown into something like a GitHub for AI in recent years, where AI builders can share and download open models and datasets, now used by roughly half the Fortune 500. Delangue has seen the same story play out again and again: companies start […]
author: Theresa Loconsolo

title: OpenAI says GPT 5.6 is the ‘preferred model’ for Microsoft Copilot 365 amid breakup chatter
description: OpenAI's new family of models will continue to power Microsoft's suite of workplace and productivity apps.
author: Lucas Ropek

title: Fidji Simo steps down from OpenAI’s no. 2 role
description: OpenAI's No. 2 executive, Fidji Simo, is stepping down from her full-time role after her medical leave proved longer than expected — a leadership vacuum that comes at a tricky time as the company eyes a possible IPO and races to catch Anthropic in the enterprise market.
author: Connie Loizos
